readme_notes.note: Consolidated evidence register for 19 NIRA-related source posts and five government/official response records.

All 19 post URLs were matched against the Account Verification worksheet. Publication dates are recorded as researcher-verified in the Publication Date Verification worksheet; POST_08, POST_10, and POST_17 were explicitly confirmed by the researcher on 2026-10-18.
Publication date confirmed as 2026-07-06, matching the date shown in the image.
Publication date confirmed as 2025-10-18. The post’s reported policy claim remains distinct from confirmation of the policy itself.

POST_17 is likely about NIRA national-ID issuance through the Somali Embassy in Uganda, corroborated by a matching SNTV report published 2025-12-25 and comments on the registered URL; the exact Facebook media item was not directly retrieved. POST_18 is likely an Eid al-Fitr seasonal greeting, inferred from comments mentioning Eid/card collection and its 2026-03-19 date immediately before Eid on 2026-03-20; the original image/caption remains unavailable. These are carefully qualified working descriptions, not verbatim confirmations. See the Content Evidence Review sheet for source links and analysis guidance.

Confirming a source URL or publication date does not by itself establish a direct government response or causation. Direct linkage requires specific documentary evidence; temporal and thematic relationships must be described separately.

Likely NIRA national-ID service through the Somali Embassy in Uganda. Corroborated by an SNTV report published 2025-12-25 and comments on the matched Facebook URL. The exact Facebook caption/video was not directly recovered; use as topic-level corroboration, not verbatim confirmation.

Likely Eid al-Fitr greeting/seasonal message, based on multiple comments mentioning Eid and requests about card collection, plus the 2026-03-19 publication date immediately before Eid al-Fitr on 2026-03-20. Original image/caption remains unrecovered; label the description as inferred, not confirmed.

content_evidence_review.working_content_description: Likely report/repost about the Somali Embassy in Uganda beginning to issue NIRA national ID cards.
content_evidence_review.evidence_summary: SNTV published a report with this exact topic on 2025-12-25. Comments associated with the registered Facebook URL refer to the Uganda embassy and NIRA cards, which aligns with the report. Other notes such as 'Eid greeting' appear inconsistent with this date/topic and are not retained as the working description.
content_evidence_review.evidence_type: Public SNTV report + comments linked to the source-post URL
content_evidence_review.confidence: High for the likely topic; not confirmed as the identical Facebook media item
content_evidence_review.guidance_for_analysis: May be used as a qualified topic-level event/source-post description. Do not quote a Facebook caption or assert exact video identity unless the original Facebook content is inspected.
content_evidence_review.remaining_limitation: Facebook URL and publication date are researcher-verified, but the original Facebook caption/video was not directly retrievable in this review.
